guarantees.claim: When UseOtpSeedsInsteadOfFlash is true, creator_seed is continuously assigned from otp_key_i.creator_seed; otherwise from flash_i.seeds[flash_ctrl_pkg::CreatorSeedIdx].

unused_creator_seed is assigned a reduced XOR of flash_i.seeds[CreatorSeedIdx] and otp_key_i.creator_seed_valid when UseOtpSeedsInsteadOfFlash is true, otherwise a reduced XOR of otp_key_i.creator_seed and otp_key_i.creator_seed_valid.

assumptions.claim: When UseOtpSeedsInsteadOfFlash is true, the external logic driving otp_key_i.creator_seed must ensure the seed is valid before it is consumed by downstream key derivation; this block does not gate on otp_key_i.creator_seed_valid.
assumptions.risk: Invalid or uninitialized seed values could be used for key derivation, leading to deterministic or weak keys.

uncertain_points.claim: otp_key_i.creator_seed_valid is only XORed into unused_creator_seed but does not gate creator_seed. If the OTP seed is not yet valid, creator_seed still propagates to key derivation, bypassing a validity check.
uncertain_points.cond: when UseOtpSeedsInsteadOfFlash is true and otp_key_i.creator_seed_valid is false
uncertain_points.risk: A bad or glitching OTP seed may be used in key creation, potentially yielding compromised or unpredictable keys.

uncertain_points.claim: unused_creator_seed is assigned but its value appears unused within this generate block; it may be a dead signal or only provided for external debug visibility.
uncertain_points.risk: No direct security risk, but an unreferenced assignment may mask intended checks or cause synthesis/simulation mismatches.
